Multiverse over the back-position choices in `turn_bc_explore.qmd`, excluding the syntax-based subsets:

| Choice | Options |
|---|---|
| Outcome | BC onset, turn onset |
| Data subset | all IUs, non-terminal IUs |
| How place enters | additive, interaction |
| Back predictor | actual; expected; actual + expected; prediction error (actual − expected) |
| Expected-back statistic | mean, median, mode (not used by actual-only) |

That is 2 × 2 × 2 × (1 + 3 + 3 + 3) = 80 specs, plus a place-only baseline per outcome × subset cell.
Every spec is a logistic GLMM with a random intercept per document, fit on the full data and with 5-fold cross-validation grouped by document.

To run as a batch job, see `run_multiverse.sbatch` next to this file.
Each spec is cached in `output/turn_bc_multiverse/`, so a rerun after a crash or timeout only fits what is missing.

```{r}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(parallel)
```

```{r}
# Each spec's fits are cached in output/turn_bc_multiverse/<spec_id>.rds;
# set the env var TURN_BC_REFIT=true (or refit_models <- TRUE) to refit everything
out_dir <- here("output", "turn_bc_multiverse")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
refit_models <- tolower(Sys.getenv("TURN_BC_REFIT", "false")) == "true"

# Use the CPUs SLURM allocated; forking isn't available on Windows
n_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  1L
} else {
  as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", max(1L, detectCores() - 1L)))
}
n_folds <- 5
cv_seed <- 2200
glmer_ctrl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))
```

# Data

```{r}
sbc <- readRDS(here("data", "turns_updated.rds"))
back_given_place_summ <- read_csv(
  here("data", "conditional_back_summary.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
sbc <- sbc %>% left_join(back_given_place_summ, by = c(text = "word", "place"))
```

BC / turn onsets, as in `turn_bc_explore.qmd`:

```{r}
# Opening-bracket label of each word, e.g. "[" or "[2" (NA if none)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(overlap_label = str_extract(transcript, "\\[\\d*"))

# Next two units (within the same doc), their turnTypes, and whether the next has any overlap
unit_info <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_turnType = first(turnType),
    unit_has_overlap = any(isOverlap %in% TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(docId, unitId) %>%
  group_by(docId) %>%
  mutate(
    next_unitId = lead(unitId),
    next_turnType = lead(unit_turnType),
    next_has_overlap = lead(unit_has_overlap),
    next2_unitId = lead(unitId, 2),
    next2_turnType = lead(unit_turnType, 2)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    docId,
    unitId,
    next_unitId,
    next_turnType,
    next_has_overlap,
    next2_unitId,
    next2_turnType
  )

# Opening brackets in each unit, keyed so they can be matched from an earlier unit
open_brackets <- sbc %>%
  filter(!is.na(overlap_label)) %>%
  distinct(docId, unitId, overlap_label)

sbc <- sbc %>%
  left_join(unit_info, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    open_brackets %>% mutate(next2_has_match = TRUE),
    by = c("docId", next2_unitId = "unitId", "overlap_label")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    next_has_match = coalesce(next_has_match, FALSE),
    # Only look two units ahead if the next unit has some (other) overlapped portion
    next2_has_match = !next_has_match &
      coalesce(next_has_overlap, FALSE) &
      coalesce(next2_has_match, FALSE),
    has_overlap_onset = next_has_match | next2_has_match,
    match_turnType = if_else(next_has_match, next_turnType, next2_turnType),
    has_bc_onset = has_overlap_onset &
      coalesce(str_detect(match_turnType, "^\\s*back"), FALSE),
    has_turn_onset = has_overlap_onset & !has_bc_onset
  ) %>%
  select(
    -c(
      next_unitId,
      next_turnType,
      next_has_overlap,
      next2_unitId,
      next2_turnType,
      next_has_match,
      next2_has_match,
      match_turnType
    )
  )

# Whether any word in the turn has a BC / turn onset (NA where turnSeq is missing)
sbc <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, turnSeq) %>%
  mutate(
    turn_has_bc_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_bc_onset)),
    turn_has_turn_onset = if_else(is.na(turnSeq), NA, any(has_turn_onset))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# endNote sits on the IU's punctuation row (place is NA there), so flag at the unit level;
# terminal = period ("final") or question mark ("appeal")
unit_terminal <- sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, unitId) %>%
  summarise(
    unit_is_terminal = any(endNote %in% c("final", "appeal")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

back_stats <- c("mean", "median", "mode")

sbc_mv <- sbc %>%
  left_join(unit_terminal, by = c("docId", "unitId")) %>%
  filter(place != 1) %>%
  # Same rows for every spec within a cell, so AIC / LRTs are comparable
  filter(
    !is.na(back),
    !is.na(mean_back),
    !is.na(median_back),
    !is.na(mode_back)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    err_mean = back - mean_back,
    err_median = back - median_back,
    err_mode = back - mode_back
  )
```

One data set per outcome × subset cell. Folds are assigned by document and shared by every spec in a cell, so CV scores are paired.

```{r}
cells <- expand_grid(outcome = c("bc", "turn"), subset = c("all", "nonterm")) %>%
  mutate(cell = paste(outcome, subset, sep = "__"))

make_cell_data <- function(outcome, subset) {
  d <- sbc_mv %>%
    filter(.data[[paste0("turn_has_", outcome, "_onset")]] %in% TRUE)
  if (subset == "nonterm") {
    d <- d %>% filter(!unit_is_terminal)
  }
  d <- d %>%
    transmute(
      docId,
      place,
      back,
      mean_back,
      median_back,
      mode_back,
      err_mean,
      err_median,
      err_mode,
      onset = as.integer(.data[[paste0("has_", outcome, "_onset")]])
    )
  docs <- sample(unique(d$docId))
  fold_of_doc <- setNames(rep_len(seq_len(n_folds), length(docs)), docs)
  d %>% mutate(fold = unname(fold_of_doc[docId]))
}

set.seed(cv_seed)
cell_data <- map2(cells$outcome, cells$subset, make_cell_data) %>%
  set_names(cells$cell)

# Keep forked workers small
rm(sbc, sbc_mv, unit_info, open_brackets, unit_terminal)
invisible(gc())

cells %>%
  mutate(
    n_words = map_int(cell_data, nrow),
    n_docs = map_int(cell_data, \(d) n_distinct(d$docId)),
    n_onsets = map_int(cell_data, \(d) sum(d$onset))
  )
```

# Specs

```{r}
back_specs <- c(
  list(none = character(0), actual = "back"),
  set_names(
    map(back_stats, \(s) paste0(s, "_back")),
    paste0("expected_", back_stats)
  ),
  set_names(
    map(back_stats, \(s) c("back", paste0(s, "_back"))),
    paste0("both_", back_stats)
  ),
  set_names(
    map(back_stats, \(s) paste0("err_", s)),
    paste0("error_", back_stats)
  )
)

specs <- expand_grid(
  cell = cells$cell,
  place_form = c("additive", "interaction"),
  back_spec = names(back_specs)
) %>%
  # The place-only baseline is the same either way, so keep one per cell
  filter(!(back_spec == "none" & place_form == "interaction")) %>%
  left_join(cells, by = "cell") %>%
  mutate(
    predictor = str_remove(back_spec, "_.*"),
    stat = str_extract(back_spec, "(?<=_)[a-z]+$"),
    spec_id = paste(cell, place_form, back_spec, sep = "__"),
    formula = map2_chr(back_spec, place_form, \(b, pf) {
      vars <- back_specs[[b]]
      fixed <- if (length(vars) == 0) {
        "place"
      } else if (pf == "additive") {
        c("place", vars)
      } else {
        paste("place *", vars)
      }
      paste("onset ~", paste(c(fixed, "(1 | docId)"), collapse = " + "))
    })
  )

stopifnot(sum(specs$predictor != "none") == 80)
specs %>% count(outcome, subset, place_form)
```

# Fitting

```{r}
auc <- function(y, p) {
  r <- rank(p)
  n1 <- sum(y == 1)
  n0 <- sum(y == 0)
  (sum(r[y == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

log_loss <- function(y, p) {
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-15), 1 - 1e-15)
  -mean(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p))
}

fit_glmer <- function(formula, d) {
  glmer(
    as.formula(formula),
    data = d,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    control = glmer_ctrl
  )
}

# Fits one spec on the full data and on each CV fold, and caches a summary
# (not the model object, which carries a copy of the data)
fit_spec <- function(spec_id, formula, cell) {
  path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(spec_id, ".rds"))
  if (!refit_models && file.exists(path) && isTRUE(readRDS(path)$ok)) {
    return(invisible(path))
  }
  d <- cell_data[[cell]]
  res <- tryCatch(
    {
      m <- fit_glmer(formula, d)
      # Out-of-sample: population-level predictions for held-out documents
      cv_pred <- map(seq_len(n_folds), \(k) {
        m_k <- fit_glmer(formula, d[d$fold != k, ])
        test <- d[d$fold == k, ]
        tibble(
          fold = k,
          onset = test$onset,
          p = predict(m_k, newdata = test, re.form = NA, type = "response")
        )
      }) %>%
        bind_rows()
      list(
        ok = TRUE,
        nobs = nobs(m),
        npar = attr(logLik(m), "df"),
        logLik = as.numeric(logLik(m)),
        AIC = AIC(m),
        BIC = BIC(m),
        singular = isSingular(m),
        conv_msgs = paste(m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages, collapse = "; "),
        coefs = as_tibble(coef(summary(m)), rownames = "term"),
        cv_pred = cv_pred
      )
    },
    error = \(e) list(ok = FALSE, error = conditionMessage(e))
  )
  saveRDS(res, path)
  invisible(path)
}
```

```{r}
fit_start <- Sys.time()
fit_log <- mclapply(
  seq_len(nrow(specs)),
  \(i) fit_spec(specs$spec_id[i], specs$formula[i], specs$cell[i]),
  mc.cores = n_cores,
  mc.preschedule = FALSE
)
Sys.time() - fit_start
```

# Results

```{r}
fits <- map(specs$spec_id, \(id) readRDS(file.path(out_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))) %>%
  set_names(specs$spec_id)

cv_metrics <- function(fit) {
  if (!isTRUE(fit$ok)) {
    return(tibble(
      cv_log_loss = NA_real_,
      cv_log_loss_se = NA_real_,
      cv_brier = NA_real_,
      cv_auc = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  pred <- fit$cv_pred
  per_fold <- pred %>%
    group_by(fold) %>%
    summarise(ll = log_loss(onset, p))
  tibble(
    cv_log_loss = log_loss(pred$onset, pred$p),
    cv_log_loss_se = sd(per_fold$ll) / sqrt(nrow(per_fold)),
    cv_brier = mean((pred$p - pred$onset)^2),
    cv_auc = auc(pred$onset, pred$p)
  )
}

results <- specs %>%
  mutate(
    ok = map_lgl(fits, \(f) isTRUE(f$ok)),
    error = map_chr(fits, "error", .default = NA_character_),
    nobs = map_dbl(fits, "nobs", .default = NA),
    npar = map_dbl(fits, "npar", .default = NA),
    logLik = map_dbl(fits, "logLik", .default = NA),
    AIC = map_dbl(fits, "AIC", .default = NA),
    BIC = map_dbl(fits, "BIC", .default = NA),
    singular = map_lgl(fits, "singular", .default = NA),
    conv_msgs = map_chr(fits, "conv_msgs", .default = NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(map(fits, cv_metrics) %>% bind_rows()) %>%
  group_by(cell) %>%
  mutate(
    dAIC_vs_place = AIC - AIC[back_spec == "none"],
    dlogloss_vs_place = cv_log_loss - cv_log_loss[back_spec == "none"]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(
  results %>% select(-formula),
  here("output", "turn_bc_multiverse_results.csv")
)
```

Failed fits, and fits with singularity or convergence warnings:

```{r}
results %>%
  filter(!ok | singular | conv_msgs != "") %>%
  select(spec_id, ok, error, singular, conv_msgs)
```

```{r}
results %>%
  arrange(cell, AIC) %>%
  select(
    outcome,
    subset,
    place_form,
    back_spec,
    npar,
    AIC,
    dAIC_vs_place,
    cv_log_loss,
    cv_auc
  )
```

## Specification curves

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
spec_order <- names(back_specs)

results %>%
  filter(predictor != "none") %>%
  mutate(back_spec = factor(back_spec, levels = spec_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = back_spec, y = dAIC_vs_place, colour = place_form)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ subset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AIC − AIC(place only)", colour = "Place") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
results %>%
  filter(predictor != "none") %>%
  mutate(back_spec = factor(back_spec, levels = spec_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = back_spec, y = 1000 * dlogloss_vs_place, colour = place_form)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ subset, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "CV log loss − place only (× 1000)",
    colour = "Place"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Expected vs actual back

Positive = actual back fits better than expected back (non-nested, so compare AIC and CV log loss).

```{r}
actual_fit <- results %>%
  filter(predictor == "actual") %>%
  select(cell, place_form, AIC_actual = AIC, ll_cv_actual = cv_log_loss)

results %>%
  filter(predictor == "expected") %>%
  inner_join(actual_fit, by = c("cell", "place_form")) %>%
  transmute(
    outcome,
    subset,
    place_form,
    stat,
    dAIC = AIC - AIC_actual,
    dlogloss_x1000 = 1000 * (cv_log_loss - ll_cv_actual)
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, subset, place_form, stat)
```

## Nested comparisons

```{r}
lrt <- function(full, reduced, by) {
  full %>%
    select(
      all_of(by),
      outcome,
      subset,
      any_of("stat"),
      ll_full = logLik,
      npar_full = npar
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      reduced %>% select(all_of(by), ll_red = logLik, npar_red = npar),
      by = by
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      chisq = 2 * (ll_full - ll_red),
      df = npar_full - npar_red,
      p = pchisq(chisq, df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    select(-c(ll_full, ll_red, npar_full, npar_red))
}
```

Does expected back add anything over actual back:

```{r}
lrt(
  results %>% filter(predictor == "both"),
  results %>% filter(predictor == "actual"),
  by = c("cell", "place_form")
) %>%
  arrange(cell, place_form, stat)
```

Does actual back (equivalently, prediction error) add anything over expected back:

```{r}
lrt(
  results %>% filter(predictor == "both"),
  results %>% filter(predictor == "expected"),
  by = c("cell", "place_form", "stat")
) %>%
  arrange(cell, place_form, stat)
```

Do the interactions with place help:

```{r}
lrt(
  results %>% filter(place_form == "interaction"),
  results %>% filter(place_form == "additive"),
  by = c("cell", "back_spec")
) %>%
  arrange(cell, back_spec)
```

## Coefficients

Back-related terms in the additive models (Wald 95% CIs):

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
coefs <- map2(fits, names(fits), \(f, id) {
  if (!isTRUE(f$ok)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  f$coefs %>% mutate(spec_id = id)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  left_join(specs %>% select(-formula), by = "spec_id")

coefs %>%
  filter(
    place_form == "additive",
    term != "(Intercept)",
    term != "place"
  ) %>%
  mutate(back_spec = factor(back_spec, levels = spec_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Estimate,
    y = back_spec,
    xmin = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    xmax = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    colour = term
  )) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  facet_grid(outcome ~ subset) +
  labs(x = "Log-odds estimate", y = NULL, colour = "Term")
```
